procedural_matters: The race committee was represented by Christina Buch.
GER 21475 and Coach Lenny Schulze (support person vessel GER 247) did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: 3 minutes before the startig signal of race 9 and 50 meters to leeward from the staring line, GER 214752 was 2 meters to leeward of support person vessel GER 247.
At that time GER 214752 was talking to her coach on support person vessel GER 247.
2 minutes before the starting signal and 50 meters to leeward from the staring line GER 214752 was 1 boat length in front of support coach vessel GER 247.
At that time GER 214752 was communicating with her coach on support person vessel GER 247 using handsignals.
conclusions: GER 214752 received help from an outside source, and broke RRS 41.
decision: Lenny Schulze shall apologize in writing to the OA within 24 hours.
